question: Does the metadata-frozen twelfth family supply three reference views, one source-admitted consecutive query triplet and a same-scene sibling before RGB/model access?

reference_memory.vacancy_fill: If positive-marginal selection stops at two, fill one remaining admitted reference by maximum minimum camera-to-target angle.

query_triplet.selection: Maximize minimum visible target vertices, then total visible vertices, minimum short-side fraction, minimum depth-visible ratio, then earlier first frame.
query_triplet.roles: First two frames are initial observations; third is the fixed NEXT_FRAME_FORWARD action observation.

next_action.evaluable: Freeze three references and the ordered query triplet, then run the unchanged scorer on all six images once and apply the truth-free 0.02 ambiguity trigger.
next_action.not_evaluable: Retain the source result and do not open RGB or call GroundingDINO, SAM2 or DINOv2 for this family.

literature_motivation.source: PInVerify: An Offline Embodied Benchmark for Active Instance Verification
literature_motivation.use: Test a minimal deterministic local observation before learned next-best-view policies.

literature_motivation.source: Active Perception for Ambiguous Objects Classification
literature_motivation.use: Use ambiguity to trigger one new view and evaluate whether it resolves ranking confusion.

forbidden_after_freeze: change family, target, source hashes, view admission, reference fill, triplet ranking, initial/action roles or sibling rule
open RGB or call a model before source result
replace a source-inadequate family using RGB/model outcomes
change the 0.02 trigger, one-action budget, NEXT_FRAME_FORWARD action, unchanged scorer or IoU gate
claim_boundary: This source gate can establish only fresh-family geometry/depth reachability for three references and an ordered consecutive query triplet. It is not RGB/model evidence, active-view confirmation, a deployable action policy, exact-instance binding, portal ownership, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
